summary: Tested 7 bug fixes for MoneySutra Family Combined View. 5 issues verified fixed, 2 require further validation due to view toggle interaction issues in automated tests. Backend APIs working correctly. Edit member endpoint verified via curl.

integration_issues.flow: Family Toggle switching to Sharma Family Combined
integration_issues.issue: Dropdown menu items don't have role='menuitem' attribute, making programmatic selection difficult. Click on 'Sharma Family' text doesn't reliably switch view in automated tests.
integration_issues.note: Manual testing may work - automated selection was inconsistent

action_items: Add data-testid attributes to Family Toggle dropdown menu items for reliable testing
Consider adding data-testid='family-option-combined' to Sharma Family option
seed_data_creation: Used existing test user: test@moneyssutra.com / test
context_for_next_testing_agent: Family Toggle dropdown works visually but needs data-testid for automation. All issues appear fixed based on code review and partial UI testing.

issue_1_family_hub_member_spacing.details: Members list uses space-y-3 class. Rahul, Priya, Son displayed with proper spacing. No overlap when member card is expanded.

issue_2_edit_option_for_family_members.details: Edit3 (pencil) icon visible next to delete button for non-owner members. Clicking opens inline edit form with Name, Relationship select, Phone (required), Email fields. Cancel and Save buttons work. Backend PUT /api/family/edit-member/{member_id} tested and working.

issue_3_health_page_financial_score.details: FinancialHealth component shows 'Sharma Family Health' with Score 69 'Good' when in family view. useIntelligenceData.js properly builds controlScore with finalScore, grade, breakdown (savingsRate, emiLoad, safetyBuffer, incomeConsistency).

issue_4_money_personality_not_opening.details: Money Personality accordion opens and shows personality data. Personal view shows 'Debt Warrior' with 100% match, Stabilizing Zone. Family view builds personality based on savings rate (Wealth Builder/Balanced Planner/etc).

issue_5_runway_data_sync.details: Emergency Runway shows Stage 13: Advancing, 186 days, Accessible Funds ₹16.2L, Monthly Essential ₹2.6L, Daily Burn Rate ₹9K/day. Liquid Buffer, Extended Buffer, Total Net Worth displayed correctly.

issue_6_badges_challenges_no_data.details: Personal view shows 43/100 badges. Family combined view shows 'Start tracking...' message which is expected since gamification is per-user, not per-family.

issue_7_action_section_strong_stability.details: ActionSection correctly shows improvement suggestions ('Increase savings by ₹31K', 'Reduce EMI by 10%') instead of 'strong stability' when safetyBuffer.score < max*0.6 or emiLoad.score < max*0.7. Logic verified in code.

code_review.FamilyPage.js: Edit form implemented with inline fields. space-y-3 for member spacing. handleEditMember function makes PUT request to /api/family/edit-member/{memberId}.
code_review.useIntelligenceData.js: Family view builds controlScore with proper breakdown structure. moneyPattern set based on savingsRate thresholds. fundBreakdown includes liquidBuffer, extendedBuffer, netWorth fields.
code_review.family.py: PUT /api/family/edit-member/{member_id} validates phone mandatory, updates member in DB.
